snippets.en: And it came to pass that we did march forth to the land of Cumorah, and we did pitch our tents around about the hill Cumorah; and it was in a land of many waters, rivers, and fountains; and here we had hope to gain advantage over the Lamanites.
snippets.tr: E aconteceu que marchamos para a terra de Cumora e armamos nossas tendas ao redor do monte Cumora; e era numa terra de muitas águas, rios e fontes; e ali tínhamos esperança de sobrepujar os lamanitas.
